target.statement: Avg Precision of Ellipse-IF on the Wine dataset (Scenario II, Normal threshold distribution) = 0.81

compute.basis: Wine is 129x13; fitting an Ellipse-IF forest and averaging 10 runs is seconds of CPU, dominated by pip install and ODDS download; main risk is that the anonymous repo may be incomplete or the exact protocol (10-run averaging, Scenario II inlier-only training, normal threshold) must be re-derived from text.

blockers: anonymous repo may be missing/outdated or lack exact configs for Scenario II + Normal threshold
